jobs.title: Our Culture
jobs.description: Our Culture - Final home About Our Culture Our Social Impact Careers Contact Our Culture join us - GET TO KNOW US - why work at final? In a world more and more dominated by learning machines and artificial intelligence, we at Final are especially proud of our humans. This elite team of exceptional people are the soul of our company, and it is our top priority to provide them with a professionally fulfilling environment that supports stable work-life balance. Our employees are encouraged to pursue their passions and are offered diverse opportunities and resources to grow, develop and improve their well-being, while enjoying the flexibility and independence to execute them. Your Impact We facilitate an environment in which our people have many opportunities to experiment, grow, gain experience and knowledge and make a significant mark. We put an emphasis on eye-level management, valuing every opinion irrespective of seniority. Our team champions bold ideas, embraces end-to-end accountability, and witnesses firsthand the fast and tangible results of their contributions. Pure Research & Technology We don't engage with external customers and marketing is not on our agenda. We set our own expectations and have the freedom to keep trying until we succeed. This approach allows our talented men and women to focus on off-the-books research and pure technology implementation without distraction. Exceptional People At Final, a commitment to professional excellence is vital. This commitment is driven by a combination of knowledge, ingenuity, curiosity and experience. Beyond that, our teams are fostering friendships, encouraging open communication, and cultivating a high level of collaboration. Together, we have created a warm, positive and supportive culture that defines the essence of our workplace. Success & Stability Since being established in 2001, Final has been at the forefront of the algorithmic trading industry. We have consistently navigated the ever-changing business landscape, and our remarkable, lasting business success has also translated into a nurturing workplace environment for our valued employees. We Care Caring is at the core of who we are. We prioritize the well-being of our people, ensuring they have the supportive work environment for them to thrive in. We extend our care to the environment and to the community around us. As a leading company in our field, we understand our responsibility to give back. We invest substantial efforts in making a meaningful impact on our community. WE ARE BETTER TOGETHER Years of shared experiences and friendships create a unique work environment that nurtures continuous success. - LEARN TO BE EXCELLENT - FINAL IN THE ACADEMIA Academia is where Final began, and we have kept a truly symbiotic relations with it ever since. From merit based scholarships, rewarding academic excellence, community service and leadership to focused research awards and direct funding for academic research - we are excited to support and encourage academic innovation and are happy to have meaningful engagements with academic faculty, researchers and students. The Final Award The Final Award has been our cherished project since 2009. Our commitment extends beyond academic excellence as we believe in fostering personal growth and community engagement. The award recognizes exceptional students in the fields of computer science, physics, electrical engineering, and mathematics, and honors excellence at both the undergraduate and master's levels. Do the math. jobs.title: Our Social Impact
jobs.description: Our Social Impact - Final home About Our Culture Our Social Impact Careers Contact Our Social Impact join us - our steps and principles - Creating a lasting change At Final, we believe that success is measured not only by financial gain, but also by the positive change we can bring to the communities in which we operate. Based in Israel, we focus on creating sustainable impact, building lasting partnerships and empowering the communities around us. That is why we have chosen to invest significant resources and concerted efforts to fulfill our commitment. To achieve our ambitions, we partner with local stakeholders to identify needs, and co-create solutions. We also utilize our people’s outstanding problem-solving skills and drive to make a tangible and lasting difference in our communities. We are proud that the majority of Final employees are actively involved in a variety of volunteering activities. They bring their own initiatives to the table and take an active role in the decision-making process that brings their ideas to life. We are happy to support and encourage their desire to give back, knowing that together, we can make a meaningful difference. Our long-term commitment to social impact is based on 4 fundamental pillars: 1. Empowering Positive Change in Local Communities Our goal is to help communities facing social and economic challenges attain substantial and long-lasting improvement. We pursue it through community partnerships, investments in resources, employee volunteering, and close collaboration with local municipalities and associations to amplify the impact. This community approach has become the core initiative of Final’s social impact activity, forming what we call our Place-Based model. The first long-term project was launched back in 2014 in the Yoseftal neighborhood in Petah Tikva. This “cradle-to-career” program was designed to build local infrastructure, enabling the neighborhood’s residents to reach their full potential. By joining forces with local and national partners and aligning goals, resources, work plans, and measurements, this comprehensive approach has resulted in significant improvement in the quality, accessibility, and utilization of social services within the community. Over the years, we observed a remarkable positive shift in residents’ sense of solidarity, belonging, pride, personal safety, and trust in public institutions. After gradually handing over the day-to-day responsibility in the Yoseftal neighborhood to local authorities and community leadership, we are now implementing this successful Place-Based model in the Shimshon neighborhood in Ashkelon . Together with local partners, Shimshon residents, and Final’s volunteers, we continue to develop local infrastructure and invest in this long-term program, aiming to create sustainable impact within the community in the years to come. This successful Place-Based model is designed to serve as a long-term framework that can be implemented in additional communities across Israel’s social and geographic periphery. 2. Advancing STEM Education and Technological Excellence in the Periphery We believe that access to high-quality mathematical and technological education can open doors to future academic, professional, and personal opportunities, regardless of where students grow up. Expanding access to advanced STEM education and mathematical excellence programs in Israel’s social and geographic periphery is another important layer of Final’s long-term social impact activity. Empowering 5-Unit Mathematics Teachers To strengthen advanced mathematics education in the Western Negev, Final supports teachers participating in a professional certification program at Ben-Gurion University, preparing them to teach 5-unit mathematics. By expanding the number of qualified teachers in the region, the program creates new opportunities for more students to access high-level mathematics studies and build a stronger foundation for future academic and technological paths. Accelerated Mathematics Program for Talented Students Together with Bar-Ilan University, Final supports an accelerated mathematics program for talented students from the Western Negev. Through advanced studies, guidance, and mentorship from Final’s employees, students work toward completing their 5-unit mathematics matriculation exams as early as 10th grade, opening new opportunities for their academic and professional future. Supporting Students on Their Journey to Science Olympiads Final supports talented students from 18 schools across the Western Negev as they prepare for the selection process of Israel’s young science team, representing the country at the International Junior Science Olympiad (IJSO). Through advanced training and a supportive learning environment, these students deepen their knowledge in chemistry, physics, and biology, while developing curiosity, independent thinking, and scientific excellence. Inspiring the Next Generation Throughout the year, Final hosts students from Israel’s social and geographic periphery, offering them a closer look into the world of technology, innovation, and career opportunities. Through personal conversations, hands-on experiences, and meetings with Final’s employees, students gain a closer look at the tech industry and are encouraged to believe in their ability to shape their own future. 3. Influencing Environmental sustainability We raise awareness and take action to promote overall energy efficiency and create a work environment and organizational culture that actively supports environmental sustainability: Green office We prioritize recycling, minimize the use of disposable dishes and employ various strategies to reduce our carbon footprint resulting from computer power consumption. Promoting renewable energy We actively seek opportunities to contribute to the development of renewable energy in Israel. We are looking for a Software Engineer specializing in ML Systems Engineering to join Final’s Development department. While vision and language models have become increasingly commoditized, Final’s proprietary deep learning models are unique, fast-evolving, and deployed in live trading across the world’s most efficient and sophisticated financial markets. Operating in this environment presents distinct scaling challenges and continuous opportunities for optimization. Success in this role requires first-principles thinking and a deep understanding of the engineering trade-offs behind high-performance DL systems. jobs.description: Webnoise - סוכנות דיגיטל, פיתוח וקידום אתרים. En שיווק דיגיטלי אתרים אודות בלוג צרו קשר Digitally Different. סוכנות דיגיטל שחושבת אחרת אנחנו סוכנות המתמחה בשיווק דיגיטלי ופיתוח אתרים. בפשטות. עם אסטרטגיה חכמה. בדיוק רב, תוך מחשבה יצירתית ותשומת לב לפרטים הקטנים. שיווק UX UI למותג Thinkers שיווק פרויקט UX UI למותג הפרימיום Thinkers, הכולל איפיון עיצוב וקונספט Microsoft Tech Days שיווק, אתרים פרויקט מיתוג דיגיטלי - בקרוב האתר שלכם מוכן לשינוי הגדול? AI Overview משנה את חוקי המשחק בגוגל SEO שינוי אלגוריתם וגרסת גוגל החדשה Digital Marketing שיווק דיגיטלי, GEO+SEO, סושיאל, קמפיינים וכל מה שביניהם קרא עוד Websites & UX/UI פיתוח אתרים מוקפדים ומותאמים אישית אפיון UX UI / עיצוב / פיתוח קרא עוד בין לקוחותינו אתרים פיתוח אתרים עיצוב אתרים מיתוג דיגיטלי UI / UX שיווק סושיאל מדיה קמפיין לידים PPC קידום אורגני SEO + GEO קידום חנות E-Commrece קידום ממומן PPC קידום ושיווק באינטרנט סוכנות דיגיטל ייעוץ נגישות תנאי שימוש מדיניות פרטיות © webnoise LTD, כל הזכויות שמורות 2026
